name: Cosmic Strike
body:
Reaching one of the peaks of cultivation knowledge, you learned a terrifying heavenly technique to strike at a creature’s soul directly.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Cosmic Soul Expert, Cosmic Suppression, and 17 ranks in Spellcraft.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic strike ability.

Cosmic Strike (Su)

Once per day, as a standard action, you may make a melee touch attack on a target creature. On a successful hit, the target creature must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failure, they suffer 1d4 temporary negative levels for 24 hours (these negative levels cannot result in permanent level loss).

For each such negative level you bestow in this way, you gain 5 temporary hit points that stacks with any other temporary hit points for one hour and you gain either a +1 bonus to your caster level or a +1 bonus to your attack rolls for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your HD.

A creature can only be under the effects of (or benefit from) one use of cosmic strike at any given time.

Special: Due to your understanding of the harmony between body and spirit, the negative levels bestowed by this ability cannot benefit an undead creature (or any creature with negative energy affinity), harming them in the same way as a negative level would usually affect a living creature.

Special: You may expend 6 ki points or 6 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic strike. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic strike in this way once for every 11 HD you possess.
